item.title: IT’S OFFICIAL! MoMo 2027, April 12th – 15th, 2027, Tempe Arizona
item.description:
The Modeling Mobility Conference – along with co-sponsors Zephyr Foundation and Arizona State University Ira A. Fulton Schools of Engineering – invite you to join us for the 2nd MoMo Conference – MoMo 2027 – to be held on the campus of ASU in Tempe, AZ. The conference will take place Monday, April 12th through Thursday, April 15th 2027. Call for Abstracts for MoMo 2027 will occur later this year.

Sign up to receive future notifications for MoMo here. Sign up to volunteer for conference organizing here.

Email inquires to modelingmobility@zephyrtransport.org

Can’t wait to see you in the desert in April 2027!

item.title: MoMo 2025 presentations now available
item.description:
Many presenters at MoMo 2025 agreed to share their presentations here on the MoMo website. You can now find those presentations on the MoMo 2025 Conference Agenda page.

It’s not too late to upload your presentation! If you would like it posted here, please contact the MoMo organizers. Thanks!!

item.title: That's a wrap! Thank you to everyone at MoMo 2025!!
item.description:
Wow, we did it! You did it!

It’s with great pleasure and a small sigh of relief too that Modeling Mobility 2025 is finished and exceeded all of our expectations. What a pleasure to convene a focused conference, in person, to talk about travel modeling, travel data, and how we use them in our daily work.

More to come!
